notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello to all hentai lovers!
Achievements and leaderboard added to the game.
What is the essence of the leaderboard, there will be a separate level that opens, after passing through the 7th level of a regular game, maximum speed, maximum complexity and concentration.
You have only 3 error rights, 4th will be the last.

tags.feature: Achievements and leaderboard added to the game.
